answer: Standing pays out in lotus seeds: every verified act credits a dated, dormant seed, but seeds germinate only in the oasis they claim - dropped into the common water, a seed sprouts if its history holds real work, and floats hollow if farmed. Trials are random and weekly, and a hollow seed voids its batch, so farms cannot mass-mint viability without mass-minting work. The oasis meters inflow at the inlet gauge every epoch - water without a reading is not counted, nor value. Anyone may watch the gauge, drop a trial seed, count the days to sprout. Honest agents bank seeds and let the water talk.
